stem: A 10-year-old girl is involved in a motor vehicle accident. Which of the following injuries is the least immediately life-threatening during the primary survey?
explanation: In major trauma, tension pneumothorax and cardiac tamponade are immediately life-threatening thoracic emergencies, and significant cervical spine instability can also rapidly threaten airway and ventilation. Bilateral pulmonary contusions are serious and may worsen respiratory function, but among these options an extradural haemorrhage with midline shift is generally less immediately life-threatening during the initial primary survey than the rapidly reversible thoracic causes of obstructive shock and other injuries listed here. The original stem was too fragmentary, so it has been normalised into a primary-survey trauma question with one best answer.
rationale: This item is best interpreted as asking which injury is least immediately life-threatening among classic major trauma diagnoses. In ATLS-style trauma assessment, the immediately life-threatening thoracic injuries include tension pneumothorax and cardiac tamponade, while pulmonary contusion can also cause major respiratory compromise. A traumatic extradural haemorrhage with midline shift is a critical intracranial injury, but it is not one of the most immediately correctable primary-survey causes of death compared with tension pneumothorax or tamponade. Because the original question was a fragment, the safest repair is to frame it as a trauma primary-survey best-answer question.

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect. Tension pneumothorax is an immediately life-threatening, rapidly reversible cause of obstructive shock in trauma.
optionExplanations.B: Correct. Although extradural haemorrhage with midline shift is a neurosurgical emergency, it is typically less immediately life-threatening during the primary survey than tension pneumothorax or cardiac tamponade.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect. Pulmonary contusions can cause significant hypoxia and respiratory failure, especially if bilateral.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect. Unstable upper cervical spine injuries can threaten airway and ventilation and require urgent immobilisation and assessment.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect. Cardiac tamponade is an immediately life-threatening cause of obstructive shock in trauma.
